Revelations in Fall#001.src: Attend the meeting in the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#001.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] のレジスタンスの拠点で会議に出る。

Revelations in Fall#002.src: Hello, everyone. Thank you for being here today.
Revelations in Fall#002.dst: みんな、今日は集まってくれてありがとう。
Revelations in Fall#002.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#003.src: It has been growing increasingly clear that there is very little we can do here to make a larger impact on Fruma.
Revelations in Fall#003.dst: ここにいても Fruma に大きな影響を与えるのは難しい。それがはっきりしてきた。
Revelations in Fall#003.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#004.src: We have been doing good for the people of Auburn! But our resources are limited, and our opportunities to take action are even more so.
Revelations in Fall#004.dst: 私たちは Auburn の人々のために良いことをしてきた！でも資源は限られ、行動の機会はもっと限られている。
Revelations in Fall#004.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#005.src: Additionally, the risks of our operation grow by the day. I do not regret taking in {u} as a member, but it's no secret that we risk more scrutiny by having them here.
Revelations in Fall#005.dst: それに活動の危険は日に日に増している。{u} を迎えたことは後悔していないけど、より注目を集めるのは周知の事実よ。
Revelations in Fall#005.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#006.src: Zeph and {u} learned yesterday that an Inquisitor is arriving in the area. We don't know what for exactly, but their presence further endangers our cause.
Revelations in Fall#006.dst: Zeph と {u} は昨日、異端審問官がこの一帯に来ると知った。目的は不明だけど、その存在は私たちの活動をさらに危うくする。
Revelations in Fall#006.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#007.src: At the festival, I received word from a contact in the Roughworks. There's a group similar to ours there, run by an old friend of mine they're called the Steel Feather.
Revelations in Fall#007.dst: 祭りで Roughworks の協力者から知らせを受けたの。向こうにも似た組織があって、私の旧友が率いる鋼の羽根というの。
Revelations in Fall#007.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#008.src: They have resources we don't, and are situated in a much more favorable position. If we're able to cross through to the Roughworks, they've agreed to host us and help plan our next moves.
Revelations in Fall#008.dst: 彼らには私たちにない資源があり、立場もずっと有利。Roughworks へ渡れれば、迎え入れて次の手を一緒に考えてくれるそうよ。
Revelations in Fall#008.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#009.src: So, what are our next moves? I don't know what you expect us to do there that we're not already able to do here.
Revelations in Fall#009.dst: で、次の手って？ここでできないことを向こうで何をしろって言うの？
Revelations in Fall#009.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#010.src: I'm still workshopping ideas, but they involve the Crown Festival. If we move quickly, we'll be able to catch it in the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#010.dst: まだ案を練っているけど、王冠祭に関わることよ。急げば Roughworks の王冠祭に間に合うわ。
Revelations in Fall#010.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#011.src: Of course, traveling to a different district presents its own risks and dangers... if any of you wish to stay here, I will respect that decision.
Revelations in Fall#011.dst: もちろん、別の地区へ行くのには相応の危険がある… 残りたい人がいれば、その決断を尊重するわ。
Revelations in Fall#011.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#012.src: Ha! And leave you to strategize all on your own? I had foreseen something along these lines, so I have already made arrangements with my work. I will join you, miss.
Revelations in Fall#012.dst: はは！あなた一人に作戦を練らせろと？こうなると予見して、仕事の方はもう手を打ってあります。お供しますよ、お嬢さん。
Revelations in Fall#012.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#013.src: An I'm definitely not sitting this one out, are you kidding? I'll follow you wherever you go, Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#013.dst: あたしも絶対に行くよ、冗談でしょ？どこへでもついていくよ、Syndra。
Revelations in Fall#013.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#014.src: I- I'll go too! Wh- what's the point of hav- having magic if I don't use it for our c- c- cause?
Revelations in Fall#014.dst: ぼ、僕も行く！ぼ、僕らの大、大義に使わないなら、ま、魔法がある意味なんてないよ！
Revelations in Fall#014.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#015.src: Eh. Don't see myself bein' much use out there, to tell you the truth, Synny. And I figure you need someone to hold down the fort while you're gone, anyhow. So I'll stay.
Revelations in Fall#015.dst: ふむ。正直、外じゃわしはあまり役に立たんよ、Synny。それに留守の間、誰かが砦を守らにゃならん。だからわしは残る。
Revelations in Fall#015.speaker: Kaio

Revelations in Fall#016.src: That would be appreciated, Kaio. I'll feel more comfortable leaving, knowing the LEaves in the Wind is safe in your care.
Revelations in Fall#016.dst: 助かるわ、Kaio。風の葉をあなたに任せられるなら、安心して発てる。
Revelations in Fall#016.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#019.src: You'll... need my medicine. So I'll go...
Revelations in Fall#019.dst: みんな… 私の薬が要るよね。だから行く…
Revelations in Fall#019.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#020.src: Sui... you can stay, if you want. I don't want to force you
Revelations in Fall#020.dst: Sui… 残りたければ残っていいのよ。無理強いはしたくない
Revelations in Fall#020.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#021.src: N-no! I want to go with you! I just... I need to say goodbye to some people. Before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#021.dst: う、ううん！一緒に行きたい！ただ… 何人かにお別れを言わなきゃ。出発する前に。
Revelations in Fall#021.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#022.dst: …わかった。あなたがそう言うなら。
Revelations in Fall#022.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#024.src: I'm forever in your debt. Thank you, again, for offering your help.
Revelations in Fall#024.dst: 一生かかっても返せない恩ね。力を貸してくれて、改めてありがとう。
Revelations in Fall#024.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#025.src: In Wynn, we have stories of people who could use magic like you. It came naturally to them, and they didn't need a focus for it.
Revelations in Fall#025.dst: Wynn には、君のように魔法を使えた人々の伝承がある。生まれつきで、触媒も必要なかった。

Revelations in Fall#026.src: Sigh... I wish I could disagree. But you're right, I need you to join us.
Revelations in Fall#026.dst: はあ… 反論したいけど。あなたの言う通り、あなたの力が必要よ。
Revelations in Fall#026.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#027.src: I still need to make preparations before we leave- namely, arranging passage across the border. I have a contact that I can... hopefully convince to help.
Revelations in Fall#027.dst: 出発前にまだ準備があるの。つまり国境越えの手配。協力者がいて… 説得できるといいけど。
Revelations in Fall#027.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#028.src: You- you can't pos- possibly mean
Revelations in Fall#028.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#029.src: Yes, Zeph, I do. It will be fine.
Revelations in Fall#029.dst: ええ、Zeph、そのまさかよ。大丈夫。
Revelations in Fall#029.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#030.src: As for the rest of you, you should make your own preparations. I don't know how long the window of opportunity will be, so make the most of the time left.
Revelations in Fall#030.dst: 他のみんなも各自準備をして。好機がいつまで続くか分からないから、残りの時間を大切にね。
Revelations in Fall#030.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#031.src: Hmn... Zeph, why the concern? We all know miss Syndra knows what she's doing! If she claims to have the situation covered, then I see no reason to doubt her!
Revelations in Fall#031.dst: ふむ… Zeph、何を心配しているのです？Syndra 嬢が心得ているのは皆知っているでしょう！任せろと言うなら疑う理由はありません！
Revelations in Fall#031.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#033.src: Ah, no matter! Come now, other children... and {u} of course! Let us all take some time to say our goodbyes. We don't know when we'll be back, after all!
Revelations in Fall#033.dst: まあ、いいでしょう！さあ他の子たちも… もちろん {u} も！皆で別れの挨拶をしましょう。いつ戻れるか分かりませんからね！
Revelations in Fall#033.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#034.src: If we'll be back at all...
Revelations in Fall#034.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#035.src: Sui... we will be back. I'll make sure of it! And you know I always keep my word for matters such as these.
Revelations in Fall#035.dst: Sui… 必ず戻ります。私が保証しますよ！こういう約束を私が守るのは知っているでしょう。
Revelations in Fall#035.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#036.src: We'll be fine, Sui. We always are.
Revelations in Fall#036.dst: 大丈夫だよ、Sui。いつもそうでしょ。
Revelations in Fall#036.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#038.src: Talk with Zeph outside the base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#038.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の拠点の外で Zeph と話す。

Revelations in Fall#040.src: I don't know if I- I'm ready for this.
Revelations in Fall#040.dst: じゅ、準備ができてるか分からない。
Revelations in Fall#040.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#041.src: But I have to be! I... I have to.
Revelations in Fall#041.dst: でも、やるしかない！私… やるしか。
Revelations in Fall#041.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#043.src: So... I r- really don't trust the Sovereign, and I- I- I'm afraid he might do s- so- something to Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#043.dst: あのさ… ぼ、僕は君主を全然信用してなくて、Syndra に、な、何かするんじゃないかって、こ、怖いんだ。
Revelations in Fall#043.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#044.src: It- it's silly, but... if y- you and I can fi- find a way over the wall without having to ask him d- directly, we could avoid a- a potential con- conflict.
Revelations in Fall#044.dst: ば、馬鹿みたいだけど… 君と僕で、あいつに頼まずに壁を越える方法を見、見つけられたら、しょ、衝突を避けられる。
Revelations in Fall#044.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#045.src: And besides, it's not like I have a- any- anything better to do...
Revelations in Fall#045.dst: それに、ど、どうせ他にやることもないし…
Revelations in Fall#045.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#046.src: So! L- let's head into town, and s- s- see if we can
Revelations in Fall#046.dst: だから！ま、町へ行って、で、できるか確かめ
Revelations in Fall#046.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#047.src: Um... excuse me, s-sorry to interrupt I overheard you were... going into town?
Revelations in Fall#047.dst: えっと… ご、ごめんね、邪魔して。二人が町に… 行くって聞こえて？
Revelations in Fall#047.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#048.src: Sui! Y- yeah, we were pl- planning on it.
Revelations in Fall#048.dst: Sui！う、うん、そのつもりだよ。
Revelations in Fall#048.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#049.src: If... if it wouldn't be too much trouble... could I maybe go with you? I, ah... have some people I want to... say goodbye to.
Revelations in Fall#049.dst: もし… もし迷惑じゃなければ… 一緒に行ってもいい？あの… お別れを言いたい人たちが… いて。
Revelations in Fall#049.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#050.src: Oh... the people at the R- Re- the Red Fox?
Revelations in Fall#050.dst: ああ… あ、赤… 赤狐の人たち？
Revelations in Fall#050.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#051.src: It's... a restaurant I, um, frequent. The owners are... nice. I wanted to thank them, for, ha, everything.
Revelations in Fall#051.dst: えっと… よく行くお店なの。店主さんたちが… 優しくて。いろいろ、ふふ、お礼を言いたくて。
Revelations in Fall#051.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#052.src: It's built atop one of th- the tallest tr- trees in {p}, too... so it'll w- wo- work for my idea too. It's jus- just outside {p}'s gates.
Revelations in Fall#052.dst: {p} で一番高い木の、ひ、ひとつの上に建ってて… ぼ、僕の考えにもぴったりなんだ。{p} の門のす、すぐ外だよ。
Revelations in Fall#052.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#053.src: Head to the Red Fox treetop café at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#053.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の樹上カフェ「赤狐」へ向かう。

Revelations in Fall#054.src: L- let's all meet up at the Re- Red Fox café. It's just ou- out- outside the {p} Gates.
Revelations in Fall#054.dst: あ、赤狐カフェで集合しよう。{p} の門のそ、外のすぐそばだよ。
Revelations in Fall#054.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#056.src: So, wh- what do you think? It's a n- nice view from up here, is- isn't it?
Revelations in Fall#056.dst: で、ど、どう？ここからの眺め、い、いいでしょ？
Revelations in Fall#056.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#057.src: I... bring the others here quite often. They, um, serve the best food in {p}...
Revelations in Fall#057.dst: みんなを… よくここに連れてくるの。{p} で、えっと、一番おいしいお店なの…
Revelations in Fall#057.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#058.src: Yeah... I'll m- mi- miss our late-night snack runs. Heh.
Revelations in Fall#058.dst: うん… 夜食の買い出し、さ、寂しくなるな。へへ。
Revelations in Fall#058.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#060.src: S- Sui, do you... want us t- to stay? We can
Revelations in Fall#060.dst: S、Sui、僕らに… の、残ってほしい？一緒に
Revelations in Fall#060.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#061.src: N-no! No, no, it's... fine. I'll go find Chen on my own. You two, um, hand something you were going to do, right?
Revelations in Fall#061.dst: う、ううん！大丈夫… 平気。Chen には一人で会いに行く。二人は、えっと、何かやることがあるんでしょ？
Revelations in Fall#061.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#062.src: We did... uh, if y- you're sure, Sui. We'll see you l- la- later?
Revelations in Fall#062.dst: あるけど… えっと、ほ、本当にいいなら。じゃあ、ま、また後で？
Revelations in Fall#062.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#063.src: Y... yes. Um, good... good luck!
Revelations in Fall#063.dst: う… うん。えっと、が… 頑張って！
Revelations in Fall#063.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#064.src: ...okay. Well, {u}, the re- reason we came here... from up h- he- from up here, we have good access to the r- roof- rooftops.
Revelations in Fall#064.dst: …よし。{u}、こ、ここに来た理由は… ここからだと、や、屋根に簡単に上れるんだ。
Revelations in Fall#064.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#065.src: I w- w- I want to see if we can ge- get over the wall. If we st- stick to the roofs, we should be able to av- avoid suspicion...
Revelations in Fall#065.dst: か、壁を越えられるか試したい。や、屋根伝いに行けば、あ、怪しまれずに済むはず…
Revelations in Fall#065.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#067.src: Follow Zeph to the tree branch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#067.dst: Zeph について [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の木の枝へ行く。

Revelations in Fall#068.src: Ah, Sui! What a pleasure to see you as always!
Revelations in Fall#068.dst: おお、Sui！いつ見ても会えて嬉しいよ！
Revelations in Fall#068.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#069.src: Hi, Chen... is, um, business going well?
Revelations in Fall#069.dst: Chen… お店は、えっと、順調？
Revelations in Fall#069.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#070.src: Hum, as well as one can hope, I would say! The Festival does always bring a rush of customers. So, should I prepare the usual for you?
Revelations in Fall#070.dst: ふむ、望める限りは上々といったところだね！祭りはいつも客が押し寄せる。さて、いつものを作ろうか？
Revelations in Fall#070.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#071.src: Oh. Um... that's very kind of you, but, no, not today. Thank you.
Revelations in Fall#071.dst: あ。えっと… ありがとう、でも今日はいいの。ごめんね。
Revelations in Fall#071.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#072.src: Very well, very well. Well, since you're here, might I ask if you've had a thought about my job offer?
Revelations in Fall#072.dst: そうかい、そうかい。ところで、せっかく来たんだ、例の仕事の話は考えてくれたかな？
Revelations in Fall#072.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#073.src: You basically know our menu inside and out by this point, so I do truly think you'd be a great fit.
Revelations in Fall#073.dst: 君はもううちのメニューを隅々まで知ってる。本当にぴったりだと思うんだよ。
Revelations in Fall#073.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#074.dst: そう… えっと。そ、そのことなんだけど…
Revelations in Fall#074.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#075.src: Okay, so... just f- fo- follow the green trails !
Revelations in Fall#075.dst: よし、じゃあ… み、緑の道筋をた、辿って！
Revelations in Fall#075.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#076.src: If you g- get lost, meet me back here.
Revelations in Fall#076.dst: ま、迷ったらここに戻って来て。
Revelations in Fall#076.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#077.src: Travel across the roof tops of {p} starting from .
Revelations in Fall#077.dst: {p} の屋根の上を から渡っていく。

Revelations in Fall#079.src: Do you, uh, w- want to take a break?
Revelations in Fall#079.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#080.src: Alright, g- good luck! Just re- remember to follow the green trail.
Revelations in Fall#080.dst: よし、が、頑張って！緑の道筋を辿るのを、わ、忘れずにね。
Revelations in Fall#080.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#081.src: I- I'll follow you soon, I'm just w- war- warming up a bit first.
Revelations in Fall#081.dst: ぼ、僕もすぐ追いかける。ちょっと、じゅ、準備運動してから。
Revelations in Fall#081.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#083.src: Just re- return here when you're ready to st- start again.
Revelations in Fall#083.dst: また始める準備ができたら、こ、ここに戻って来て。
Revelations in Fall#083.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#084.src: Ha, I- I guess you got here b- be- before me this time!
Revelations in Fall#084.dst: はは、こ、今回は君の方がさ、先に着いたね！
Revelations in Fall#084.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#086.dst: よし… と、跳び越えよう。
Revelations in Fall#086.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#087.src: Aah! I... I... th- that was... c- cl- close.
Revelations in Fall#087.dst: うわっ！ぼ、僕… い、今の… あ、危なかった。
Revelations in Fall#087.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#088.src: That was... th- that was m- magic, wasn't it...? It was l- li- it was like my whole body was... w- was en- engulfed by a, a g- ge- gentle breeze...
Revelations in Fall#088.dst: 今のは… ま、魔法、だよね…？まるで全身が… や、優しいそよ風に、つ、包まれたみたいだった…
Revelations in Fall#088.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#089.src: I... ha. Th- that was- e- e- exhilarating, but... b- but... Th- there- there's no way we c- ca- we can get across these r- ro- rooftops... one c- cl- one close call is enough f- for me.
Revelations in Fall#089.dst: ぼ、僕… はは。す、すごくスリルがあったけど… で、でも… こ、この屋根を伝って越えるのは、む、無理だよ… 危ない目は一度で、じゅ、十分。
Revelations in Fall#089.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#090.src: Ugh... l- let's just... get back to the R- Red Fox...
Revelations in Fall#090.dst: うう… あ、赤狐に… 戻ろう…
Revelations in Fall#090.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#091.src: Return to The Red Fox and talk to Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#091.dst: 赤狐に戻り、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Zeph と話す。

Revelations in Fall#092.src: I just... I- I- I don't like it. I don't like that S- Syn- Syndra's putting herself in- in danger like that!
Revelations in Fall#092.dst: ぼ、僕はただ… い、嫌なんだ。S、Syndra があんな風に自分を、き、危険にさらすのが！
Revelations in Fall#092.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#093.src: I... I owe her a lot. If it weren't for her, I- I- I'd still be st- stuck on the... the st- str- streets. It's thanks to her that I'm still... here.
Revelations in Fall#093.dst: 僕は… 彼女に大きな恩がある。彼女がいなかったら、ぼ、僕は今も、ろ、路上暮らしだった。僕が今… ここにいるのは彼女のおかげ。
Revelations in Fall#093.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#094.src: Yeah... I, uh, grew up in a- a small village. S- someone was accused of being c- cursed, and... my people refused to h- ha- hand them over without a- a- wi- without a fight.
Revelations in Fall#094.dst: うん… ぼ、僕は、ち、小さな村で育ったんだ。あ、ある人が呪われてると訴えられて… 村のみんなは、た、戦わずに引き渡すのを拒んだ。
Revelations in Fall#094.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#095.src: ...actually, wh- where is she? I th- thought she'd wait for us before...
Revelations in Fall#095.dst: …そ、そういえば、彼女はどこ？ま、待っててくれると思ってたのに…
Revelations in Fall#095.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#096.src: Ah, Zeph, is that you I hear?
Revelations in Fall#096.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#097.src: Oh, h- hey Chen. I need to get going, but have you seen Sui? We were g- go- going to meet up here.
Revelations in Fall#097.dst: あ、や、やあ Chen。もう行かなきゃだけど、Sui を見なかった？こ、ここで待ち合わせてたんだ。
Revelations in Fall#097.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#098.src: Yes, Sui... she left not long ago. The poor girl, clearly something is weighing on her...
Revelations in Fall#098.dst: ああ、Sui… 少し前に出て行ったよ。かわいそうに、何か思い悩んでいるようだった…
Revelations in Fall#098.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#099.src: I believe she would have gone to the pond to the southeast... that is where she usually goes when she needs some air.
Revelations in Fall#099.dst: たぶん南東の池に行ったんじゃないかな… 気分を変えたい時、あの子はいつもそこへ行くんだ。
Revelations in Fall#099.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#100.src: Oh, I s- see. Th- thank you for the help!
Revelations in Fall#100.dst: そ、そっか。て、手伝ってくれてありがとう！
Revelations in Fall#100.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#101.src: Of course, anything for you children. Stop by again soon, would you? I'll make you all the family platter, on the house.
Revelations in Fall#101.dst: いいんだよ、君たちのためなら。また近いうちにおいで。家族盛り合わせをご馳走するよ、店のおごりでね。
Revelations in Fall#101.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#102.src: I... y- yeah, we... we will! Thanks for the off- offer.
Revelations in Fall#102.dst: ぼ、僕… う、うん… 来るよ！さ、誘ってくれてありがとう。
Revelations in Fall#102.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#104.src: {u}, can I ask you a f- fa- favour?
Revelations in Fall#104.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#105.src: Could you ch- check on Sui for me, p- please? I... I don't know h- how to help her, right now...
Revelations in Fall#105.dst: Sui の様子を、み、見てきてくれない？今の僕じゃ… ど、どう助ければいいか分からなくて…
Revelations in Fall#105.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#106.src: S- some- something's on her mind, but... b- but she won't tell me about it. I've tr- tried asking, but...
Revelations in Fall#106.dst: な、何か悩んでるんだけど… で、でも話してくれないんだ。き、聞いてはみたけど…
Revelations in Fall#106.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#107.src: ...but if you ask, ma- maybe she'll tell you? I- I don't know. It's worth a try, at- at least, r- r- right?
Revelations in Fall#107.dst: …でも君が聞けば、は、話してくれるかも？わ、分からないけど。試す価値は、あ、あるよね？
Revelations in Fall#107.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#108.src: Th- thanks, {u}. Chen said she w- was at the pond to the southeast.
Revelations in Fall#108.dst: あ、ありがとう、{u}。Chen の話だと南東の池にいるって。
Revelations in Fall#108.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#109.src: Meet up with Sui near the pond at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#109.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の池のそばで Sui と会う。

Revelations in Fall#111.src: O-oh, {u}! I didn't... um, expect to see you here.
Revelations in Fall#111.dst: あ、{u}！こんな所で… えっと、会うとは思わなかった。
Revelations in Fall#111.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#112.src: Oh... right. I just... needed some air. It's, hah, kind of a lot. L-leaving Auburn, I mean! I've never... known anywhere else.
Revelations in Fall#112.dst: あ… うん。ちょっと… 外の空気が吸いたくて。いろいろ、ふふ、あって。Auburn を、は、離れるなんて！他の場所… 知らないから。
Revelations in Fall#112.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#114.src: Can I... tell you something? I was... I wanted to talk to you, earlier, but, um, I... I couldn't build up the courage.
Revelations in Fall#114.dst: 話… 聞いてくれる？さっきも… 話したかったんだけど、えっと… 勇気が出なくて。
Revelations in Fall#114.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#116.src: S-sorry, I should just... go for it. It- it might be easier if I just, show you, hah...
Revelations in Fall#116.dst: ご、ごめん、思い切って… 言うね。み、見せた方が早いかも、ふふ…
Revelations in Fall#116.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#117.src: You're the first, um, cursed one I've ever... seen. And- and everyone being so kind, about, all of it...
Revelations in Fall#117.dst: あなたは、えっと、私が初めて… 会った呪われし者なの。それに、み、みんなが優しくて、その全部に…
Revelations in Fall#117.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#118.src: And, I thought, maybe... maybe you could... help. Me. W-with figuring it all out.
Revelations in Fall#118.dst: だから… あなたなら… 助けてくれるかもって。わ、私が答えを見つけるのを。
Revelations in Fall#118.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#120.src: But... I don't use, um, a focus. To... to control water. S-so, that means I'm, one of the... d-dangerous ones. That's... th-that's what Mora said, um, earlier.
Revelations in Fall#120.dst: でも… 私、えっと、触媒を使わずに… 水を操れるの。だ、だから、私は… き、危険な方ってこと。さっき、えっと、Mora がそう言ってた。
Revelations in Fall#120.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#121.dst: そ、そんなの分からないよ！
Revelations in Fall#121.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#123.dst: あなたの友達… その人は…？
Revelations in Fall#123.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#124.src: Oh... g-good. That's- that's good. I'm glad.
Revelations in Fall#124.dst: あ… よ、良かった。それなら、良かった。
Revelations in Fall#124.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#125.src: Oh... that's, ha, a big thing to do for someone. B-breaking into a province? I can't imagine, um, doing something like that...
Revelations in Fall#125.dst: そっか… それって、ふふ、すごいことだね。ち、地方に乗り込むなんて？私には、えっと、想像もできない…
Revelations in Fall#125.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#127.src: I'm just... scared. I'm scared that- that if I try to use it, then, I'll h-hurt someone...
Revelations in Fall#127.dst: 私… 怖いの。使おうとしたら… だ、誰かを傷つけちゃうんじゃないかって…
Revelations in Fall#127.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#128.src: I'm... not very brave, haha. I didn't, really, join the resistance because... because I wanted to stand up against the crown!
Revelations in Fall#128.dst: 私… 勇敢じゃないの、ふふ。レジスタンスに入ったのも… 王家に立ち向かいたかったからじゃない！
Revelations in Fall#128.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#129.src: Something like that, it feels... impossible.
Revelations in Fall#129.dst: そんなこと、とても… 無理に思える。
Revelations in Fall#129.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#130.src: ... I'm only here because I followed Mora. He's the brave one! N-not- not me. I just, ha, had nowhere else to go.
Revelations in Fall#130.dst: …ここにいるのは Mora についてきたから。勇敢なのは Mora！わ、私じゃない。他に、ふふ、行く所がなかっただけ。
Revelations in Fall#130.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#131.src: And- and everyone else is so, excited about m-ma-magic! Even, um, Mora. And here I am, too afraid to- to even try!
Revelations in Fall#131.dst: それに、み、みんな魔、魔法に夢中で！Mora まで。なのに私は、た、試すのも怖いなんて！
Revelations in Fall#131.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#133.src: Yeah, but... it- it wouldn't feel, um, right. If the rest of my family is going, then, ha, how could I not go with them?
Revelations in Fall#133.dst: うん、でも… それは、えっと、違う気がする。家族のみんなが行くなら、ふふ、私だけ残れないよ。
Revelations in Fall#133.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#134.src: WHat if... something happened to them to you and, and, and- and I wasn't, there? I'd... I'd never f-forgive myself!
Revelations in Fall#134.dst: もし… みんなや、あなたに何かあって、そ、その時私がいなかったら？私… 自分を、ゆ、許せない！
Revelations in Fall#134.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#135.src: So... s-so, even if I'm scared... I can't stay behind.
Revelations in Fall#135.dst: だから… だ、だから、怖くても… 残るわけにいかない。
Revelations in Fall#135.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#136.src: ...I'm, um, not much of a fighter. But I'm still good with m-medicine, and healing. So... I can help.
Revelations in Fall#136.dst: …私、えっと、戦うのは苦手。でも、く、薬と手当ては得意だから。だから… 役に立てる。
Revelations in Fall#136.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#137.src: Let's... get back home. I should tell Zeph I'm alright.
Revelations in Fall#137.dst: 帰ろう… 家に。Zeph に大丈夫って伝えなきゃ。
Revelations in Fall#137.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#138.src: Return to the Leaves in the Wind at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#139.src: Thank you for listening to me.
Revelations in Fall#139.dst: 話を聞いてくれてありがとう。
Revelations in Fall#139.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#140.src: I... I want to help. I'm just... scared.
Revelations in Fall#140.dst: 私… 役に立ちたい。ただ… 怖いの。
Revelations in Fall#140.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#141.src: Hrmm... ah, {u}, just the leaf I was looking to find!
Revelations in Fall#141.dst: ふむ… おお、{u}、ちょうど探していた葉っぱですよ！
Revelations in Fall#141.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#142.src: I am nearly finished with preparations for our expedition. Supplies packed, goodbyes said, and so on and so forth.
Revelations in Fall#142.dst: 遠征の準備はほぼ終わりました。荷造りも、別れの挨拶も、何やかやと済ませましてね。
Revelations in Fall#142.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#143.src: There is... one last thing, however. If I may ask you for a favor?
Revelations in Fall#143.dst: ただ… 最後にひとつ。頼みごとをしてもよろしいですか？
Revelations in Fall#143.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#144.src: Excellent! I thank you for your time.
Revelations in Fall#144.dst: 素晴らしい！お時間に感謝します。
Revelations in Fall#144.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#145.src: ...ah, a busy day, I take it? I promise it will be quick, if you would hear me out.
Revelations in Fall#145.dst: …おや、お忙しいようで？すぐ済みますから、話だけでも聞いてください。
Revelations in Fall#145.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#146.src: I had mentioned previously, your words on magic had resonated with me! I have been taking some time to practice, with the aid of cursory knowledge of military blessings.
Revelations in Fall#146.dst: 前にも言いましたが、魔法についてのあなたの言葉が心に響きましてね！軍の祝福の知識を少し頼りに、練習を重ねていたのです。
Revelations in Fall#146.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#147.src: But such training will do me little good in a true combat scenario. So, in the interest of improvement, I would ask for a sparring match against you!
Revelations in Fall#147.dst: ですが、そんな修練は実戦ではあまり役に立ちません。そこで上達のため、あなたに手合わせを願いたい！
Revelations in Fall#147.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#148.src: It will help me to spot and shore up my weaknesses. Perhaps it will do the same for you!
Revelations in Fall#148.dst: 自分の弱点を見つけて補えます。あなたにとってもそうかもしれませんよ！
Revelations in Fall#148.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#149.src: Come, follow me to our sparring arena!
Revelations in Fall#149.dst: さあ、稽古場までついて来てください！
Revelations in Fall#149.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#150.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Mora と手合わせする。

Revelations in Fall#151.dst: よろしい！始めましょう！
Revelations in Fall#151.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#152.src: Oof... you are very talented, I must say!
Revelations in Fall#152.dst: うっ… 実に才能がおありだ！
Revelations in Fall#152.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#153.src: No wonder miss Syndra is so invested in you, having battled you herself!
Revelations in Fall#153.dst: Syndra 嬢があなたに入れ込むわけです、自ら戦っただけに！
Revelations in Fall#153.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#154.src: Now, tell me, how did I perform?
Revelations in Fall#154.dst: さて、私の戦いぶりはどうでした？
Revelations in Fall#154.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#155.src: Really! In the moment, it did not feel like I stood much of a chance, but I suppose I am still learning to wield it!
Revelations in Fall#155.dst: 本当に！その時は勝ち目がないと感じましたが、まだ扱い方を学んでいる途中なのでしょう！
Revelations in Fall#155.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#156.src: It is odd, though. I have only learned of it recently, yet it fels as though the magic has been with me all along! It is like... muscle memory, I suppose? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#156.dst: しかし妙です。知ったのはつい最近なのに、この魔法はずっと私と共にあったように感じる！いわば… 体が覚えている、とでも？考えさせられますね。
Revelations in Fall#156.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#157.src: Ha! No need to sugarcoat it. I have always specialized in heavy attacks, so I struggle against swift opponents. Rarely have I managed to best Zeph in a spar!
Revelations in Fall#157.dst: はは！お世辞は結構。私は昔から重い一撃が得意で、素早い相手は苦手なのです。手合わせで Zeph に勝てたことはほとんどありません！
Revelations in Fall#157.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#158.src: Perhaps therein lies the value of this magic... finding methods to raise area of effect, or slow targets down? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#158.dst: この魔法の価値はそこにあるのかもしれません… 攻撃範囲を広げる、敵の動きを鈍らせる方法を探すとか？考えさせられますね。
Revelations in Fall#158.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#159.src: An excellent question, though I have no true answers. Perhaps some of what I had learned from military sources has stuck with me?
Revelations in Fall#159.dst: 良い質問ですが、本当の答えは持ち合わせていません。軍の資料で学んだことが身についているのかも？
Revelations in Fall#159.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#160.src: I do trust it will come to Zeph with time. He is persistent! That trait will serve him well for these purposes.
Revelations in Fall#160.dst: Zeph もいずれ身につけると信じていますよ。彼は粘り強い！その資質がきっと役立ちます。
Revelations in Fall#160.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#161.src: Hey, Mora! Have you seen- oh, there you are. I've been looking for you.
Revelations in Fall#161.dst: ねえ、Mora！見なかった― あ、いた。探してたんだよ。
Revelations in Fall#161.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#162.src: I had a friend... he was also from Fruma, and he was "cursed." And he was also struggling with that label, like you.
Revelations in Fall#162.dst: 友達がいた… 彼も Fruma 出身で、「呪われて」いた。そして君と同じく、その烙印に苦しんでいた。

Revelations in Fall#163.src: But he found ways to make peace with it. He used his abilities to strengthen himself and his allies. He made a difference.
Revelations in Fall#163.dst: でも彼は折り合いをつける方法を見つけた。能力で自分と仲間を強くし、変化をもたらしたんだ。

Revelations in Fall#164.src: Alright, {u}, come with me. We are SORTING through our problems before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#164.dst: よし、{u}、ついて来て。出発前に問題を「整理」するよ。
Revelations in Fall#164.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#165.src: Come on, come on! To the giant tree stump, I don't have all day!
Revelations in Fall#165.dst: ほら、早く早く！大きな切り株まで、暇じゃないんだから！
Revelations in Fall#165.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#166.src: ... Ah. Oh dear. She appears to be in a mood today! I suppose that would make sense, given...
Revelations in Fall#166.dst: …ああ。おやおや。今日の彼女はご機嫌斜めのようだ！まあ、無理もありませんが…
Revelations in Fall#166.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#167.src: Hmm, how should I put it...? Ah, nevermind. You'd best follow her to the tree, see what she wants.
Revelations in Fall#167.dst: ふむ、何と言えばいいか…？ああ、いいです。木までついて行って、用件を聞いてあげてください。
Revelations in Fall#167.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#168.src: Keep an eye on her for me, would you? Make sure she gets home safely.
Revelations in Fall#168.dst: 彼女を見ていてあげてくれますか？無事に帰れるように。
Revelations in Fall#168.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#169.src: Find Rex at the old tree stump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#169.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の古い切り株で Rex を探す。

Revelations in Fall#170.src: Keep an eye on Rex, would you? I haven't seen her this worked up in a while...
Revelations in Fall#170.dst: Rex を見ていてくれますか？あんなに興奮した彼女は久しぶりで…
Revelations in Fall#170.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#171.src: Good, you came. Took you long enough!
Revelations in Fall#171.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#172.src: So, here's the deal! You are a problem.
Revelations in Fall#172.dst: で、話はこう！あんたが問題なの。
Revelations in Fall#172.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#173.src: Sure, you've proven yourself a hundred times over! Over and over and over again, you've shown you're on our side.
Revelations in Fall#173.dst: そりゃ、あんたは百回も証明したよ！何度も何度も何度も、こっちの味方だって示してきた。
Revelations in Fall#173.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#174.src: And that's great! That's great and all! But. But but but but but! You're still. From. Wynn.
Revelations in Fall#174.dst: それはいいの！すごくいいの！でも。でもでもでもでも！あんたは。Wynn から。来た。
Revelations in Fall#174.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#175.src: Or... originally from Fruma, whatever. That's actually the problem! If you were just from Wynn, maybe it wouldn't be so bad!
Revelations in Fall#175.dst: それか… 元は Fruma 出身、どっちでもいい。それが問題なんだって！Wynn 出身なだけなら、そこまでじゃなかったかも！
Revelations in Fall#175.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#176.src: There's oh so many people from Fruma who were shipped off to Wynn! They really like sending off the problem children whenever they can't deal with them anymore.
Revelations in Fall#176.dst: Fruma から Wynn に送られた人は山ほどいる！手に負えない問題児がいると、すぐ送り出したがるんだから。
Revelations in Fall#176.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#177.src: So I get it! I do! It makes sense! But still... still, why, why... why does it get to be YOU here, and not- not...!
Revelations in Fall#177.dst: だから分かる！本当に！筋は通ってる！でもさ… なんで、なんで… ここにいるのが「あんた」で、あの人じゃ…！
Revelations in Fall#177.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#180.src: Oh, don't look at me like that.
Revelations in Fall#180.dst: ちょっと、そんな目で見ないで。
Revelations in Fall#180.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#181.src: So I had a brother, right? And sure, he was an idiot sometimes, but- but he was the only one there who really understood me.
Revelations in Fall#181.dst: あたしには兄さんがいたの。時々バカだったけど― でも、あそこで本当にあたしを分かってくれたのは兄さんだけだった。
Revelations in Fall#181.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#182.src: He's the one who carved my bow for me. He heard I was interested in archery, so he... when everyone else told me to just focus on schoolwork, he helped me learn.
Revelations in Fall#182.dst: この弓は兄さんが削ってくれたの。弓に興味があるって聞いて… みんなが勉強だけしてろって言う中、兄さんが教えてくれた。
Revelations in Fall#182.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#183.src: He really hated all the rules we had up there. So he liked to break them. A lot. And eventually, the crown got sick of it. Packed him up, sent him to the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#183.dst: 兄さんは上の規則が大嫌いで、よく破ってた。何度も。そのうち王家がうんざりして、兄さんを荷物みたいに Roughworks へ送った。
Revelations in Fall#183.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#184.src: The worst part was, our parents agreed to it! Said it'd be good for him, to get some real hard work!
Revelations in Fall#184.dst: 最悪なのは、親が賛成したこと！本当の重労働は兄さんのためになるって！
Revelations in Fall#184.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#185.src: I never liked it there anyway. It took me a while to build up the courage, but eventually I stole some of our money and bought a ticket to take me there.
Revelations in Fall#185.dst: どうせあそこは好きじゃなかった。勇気を出すのに時間がかかったけど、結局家のお金を盗んで、向こう行きの切符を買った。
Revelations in Fall#185.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#186.src: I didn't pack a whole lot. I guess I expected to find him and live with him! Stupid. Should've thought ahead more.
Revelations in Fall#186.dst: 荷物はろくに持たなかった。兄さんと一緒に暮らせると思ってたんだろうね！バカみたい。もっと考えるべきだった。
Revelations in Fall#186.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#187.src: He wasn't there, obviously. Heard from some of his friends that he kept being stupid over there. Got caught by the crown, and they decided to stop giving him second chances.
Revelations in Fall#187.dst: もちろん兄さんはいなかった。友達の話じゃ、向こうでもバカを続けてたって。王家に捕まって、もう次のチャンスはないと決められた。
Revelations in Fall#187.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#188.src: So, he's gone! He promised he'd see me again someday, and and of course he didn't follow through. I guess I wasn't important enough to remember.
Revelations in Fall#188.dst: だから、いなくなった！いつかまた会うって約束したのに、当然守らなかった。あたしは覚えておくほど大事じゃなかったんだろうね。
Revelations in Fall#188.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#189.src: Yes, I know. I just... I guess I just hoped I'd be an exception.
Revelations in Fall#189.dst: うん、分かってる。ただ… 自分は例外だと思いたかったんだと思う。
Revelations in Fall#189.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#191.src: I haven't been very fair to you, have I? It's not your fault you're here and he isn't.
Revelations in Fall#191.dst: あんたにずっと不公平だったよね？あんたがここにいて兄さんがいないのは、あんたのせいじゃない。
Revelations in Fall#191.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#193.src: So... sorry. For all of that.
Revelations in Fall#193.dst: だから… ごめん。いろいろと。
Revelations in Fall#193.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#195.src: Give me some time, would you? I need to... I don't know. I just need some space.
Revelations in Fall#195.dst: 少し時間をくれる？あたし… 分かんない。ただ一人になりたい。
Revelations in Fall#195.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#196.dst: はは！兄さんなら、そう言うよね…
Revelations in Fall#196.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#197.src: Okay. I... won't take too long. Nobody ever comes here, anyway.
Revelations in Fall#197.dst: うん。あたし… すぐ戻る。どうせここには誰も来ないし。
Revelations in Fall#197.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#198.src: Return to the camp and finish packing up at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#198.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の拠点に戻り、荷造りを終える。

Revelations in Fall#200.src: I just hope he's still out there, somewhere...
Revelations in Fall#200.dst: どこかで、まだ生きてるといいな…
Revelations in Fall#200.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#201.src: Th- there you are! We, uh, got worried s- some- something bad might've happened.
Revelations in Fall#201.dst: こ、ここにいた！ぼ、僕ら、な、何かあったんじゃないかって心配してたんだ。
Revelations in Fall#201.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#202.src: I... I mean... th- they got worried.
Revelations in Fall#202.dst: ぼ、僕… いや… み、みんなが心配してた。
Revelations in Fall#202.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#204.src: We were just talking. Gods, you guys and your overeager imaginations...
Revelations in Fall#204.dst: 話してただけ。まったく、みんな想像力がたくましすぎ…
Revelations in Fall#204.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#206.src: I am afraid not. We have heard nothing since the meeting this morning.
Revelations in Fall#206.dst: 残念ながら。今朝の会議以来、何の知らせもありません。
Revelations in Fall#206.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#207.dst: えっと… じゃあ、荷ほどき… する？
Revelations in Fall#207.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#208.src: Let us just continue to place our trust in Syndra, as we have done many times before! She can handle herself.
Revelations in Fall#208.dst: これまで何度もそうしてきたように、Syndra を信じ続けましょう！彼女なら大丈夫です。
Revelations in Fall#208.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#209.src: Ugh! I knew t- tr- trusting the Sovereign w- was a mistake! We n- n- need to go
Revelations in Fall#209.dst: うう！く、君主を信じるのはま、間違いだって分かってた！い、い、行かないと
Revelations in Fall#209.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#210.src: Excuse me- the Sovereign? What do you mean the S-
Revelations in Fall#210.dst: ちょっと― 君主？君主ってどういう―
Revelations in Fall#210.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#212.src: Sigh... I'm just a little too late, I see.
Revelations in Fall#212.dst: はあ… 少し遅かったみたいね。
Revelations in Fall#212.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#213.src: Well, since it's out in the open, I might as well explain myself. Firstly, I owe you all an apology for this.
Revelations in Fall#213.dst: まあ、知られてしまったなら、説明しておくわ。まず、みんなに謝らないといけない。
Revelations in Fall#213.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#215.src: Mora, it's alright. I was going to reveal this secret anyway.
Revelations in Fall#215.dst: Mora、いいの。どのみちこの秘密は明かすつもりだった。
Revelations in Fall#215.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#216.src: The contact I mentioned earlier today - it's the Sovereign Zhiraok.
Revelations in Fall#216.dst: 今朝話した協力者― それは君主 Zhiraok よ。
Revelations in Fall#216.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#218.src: What?! How long have you been- wait, Mora, you knew?
Revelations in Fall#218.dst: はあ？！いつから― 待って、Mora、知ってたの？
Revelations in Fall#218.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#219.src: It was a secret kept out of necessity. As for how long... let's say a while, and leave it at that. But we're leaving the {p}, so I see no need to keep it hidden anymore.
Revelations in Fall#219.dst: 必要があって隠していた秘密よ。いつからかは… しばらく前から、とだけ言っておく。でも {p} を離れる以上、もう隠す必要はないわ。
Revelations in Fall#219.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#220.src: I know you all worry about me... and I did not want to add another variable to stress over today. I apologize.
Revelations in Fall#220.dst: みんなが私を心配しているのは分かってる… 今日、心配の種を増やしたくなかったの。ごめんなさい。
Revelations in Fall#220.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#221.dst: それで… パスポートは？
Revelations in Fall#221.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#222.src: Yes, I have them. Zhiraok provided me with enough for all of us. We'll need to move fast, though I want to cross into the Roughworks before he suspects what's going on.
Revelations in Fall#222.dst: ええ、手に入れた。Zhiraok が全員分用意してくれたわ。でも急がないと― 彼に勘づかれる前に Roughworks へ渡りたいの。
Revelations in Fall#222.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#223.src: ...s- so you're safe? It all w- went fine?
Revelations in Fall#223.dst: …じゃ、じゃあ無事なんだね？う、うまくいったの？
Revelations in Fall#223.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#224.src: Yes, Zeph, I am safe. Are you all packed? Crossing the border will take some time, so we need to start going to {p} now.
Revelations in Fall#224.dst: ええ、Zeph、無事よ。みんな荷造りは済んだ？国境越えには時間がかかるから、今すぐ {p} へ向かわないと。
Revelations in Fall#224.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#225.src: Come on, let's hurry. Let us leave this chapter behind.
Revelations in Fall#225.dst: さあ、急ぎましょう。この章は置いていくの。
Revelations in Fall#225.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#226.src: Walk through the gate to the Roughworks at in {p}.
Revelations in Fall#226.dst: {p} の にある Roughworks への門をくぐる。

Revelations in Fall#228.src: I-I a-am ready for this. I have to be.
Revelations in Fall#228.dst: じゅ、準備はできてる。やるしかないんだ。
Revelations in Fall#228.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#229.src: I guess this is really happening...
Revelations in Fall#229.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#231.src: Let's meet up at the gate to the Roughworks and walk through together!
Revelations in Fall#231.dst: Roughworks への門で合流して、一緒にくぐりましょう！
Revelations in Fall#231.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#232.src: Oh... there you are. The, um, line was really long when we got here, so, we... started queuing.
Revelations in Fall#232.dst: あ… 来たね。着いた時、えっと、列がすごく長くて、だから… 先に並んでたの。
Revelations in Fall#232.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#233.src: Everything's... fine, so far. I think. I... hope.
Revelations in Fall#233.dst: 今のところ… 大丈夫。たぶん。そう… 願ってる。
Revelations in Fall#233.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#235.dst: あ、ご、ごめんなさい、ごめんなさい、私
Revelations in Fall#235.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#236.dst: これ！私の、えっと、パスポート。
Revelations in Fall#236.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#238.src: All good. Keep it moving. NEXT!
Revelations in Fall#238.speaker: Passport Officer

Revelations in Fall#243.src: We're through. That went... smoothly enough.
Revelations in Fall#243.dst: 抜けたわ。まあ… 順調だったわね。
Revelations in Fall#243.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#244.dst: い、今のは… き、緊張した。
Revelations in Fall#244.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#247.src: Enough of that, children. Miss Syndra, we've reached the Roughworks, yes?
Revelations in Fall#247.dst: そこまでです、子どもたち。Syndra 嬢、Roughworks に着いたのですね？
Revelations in Fall#247.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#248.src: We have. We'll follow the plan regroup outside {p}, the city in the region. We need to move quickly, I don't know how much time we have before
Revelations in Fall#248.dst: ええ。計画通り、この地域の都市 {p} の外で合流する。急がないと、どれだけ時間があるか分からない、その前に
Revelations in Fall#248.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#249.src: Zero, Syndra. You've got zero time.
Revelations in Fall#249.dst: ゼロだ、Syndra。君の時間はゼロだ。
Revelations in Fall#249.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#250.src: ... Sovereign. Fast and efficient as always, I see.
Revelations in Fall#250.dst: …君主。相変わらず速くて効率的ね。
Revelations in Fall#250.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#251.src: Naturally, you completely miscalculated, thinking you could sneak by like this. An unwanted variable isn't an unexpected one.
Revelations in Fall#251.dst: 当然だ、こんな風にすり抜けられると思うとは、完全な計算違いだな。望まぬ変数は、予期せぬ変数ではない。
Revelations in Fall#251.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#252.src: It was worth a shot, even if unlikely.
Revelations in Fall#252.dst: 望み薄でも、試す価値はあった。
Revelations in Fall#252.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#253.src: What garbage. Translating yourself into the Roughworks completely nulls the crown's pact... As if you wouldn't be spotted.
Revelations in Fall#253.dst: 戯言を。Roughworks へ自分を平行移動すれば、王家との協定は完全に無効だ… 見つからないとでも思ったか。
Revelations in Fall#253.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#254.src: I'm the one who really miscalculated though! Your angle was so obvious, but I just kept overlooking it. Kept trusting you. Kept hoping you'd settle, you'd terminate this sequence.
Revelations in Fall#254.dst: だが本当に計算を誤ったのは私だ！君の狙いは明白なのに見過ごし続けた。信じ続けた。君が落ち着き、この数列を終わらせると願い続けた。
Revelations in Fall#254.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#255.src: And here you are...associating with a mass murderer! The cursed that caused the Torann massacre!! What kind of lowest-order logic is this?! What were you THINKING?!
Revelations in Fall#255.dst: それがこれか… 大量殺人者とつるむとは！Torann の虐殺を起こした呪われし者だぞ！！何という最低次の論理だ？！何を「考えて」いた？！
Revelations in Fall#255.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#257.src: Isn't it obvious, Sovereign? I was Her Majesty dethroned. I want her empire to crumble.
Revelations in Fall#257.dst: 分かりきっているでしょう、君主？女王陛下の失脚を望んでいたの。帝国が崩れ落ちるのを。
Revelations in Fall#257.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#258.src: Your job was to infiltrate, not sum to the resistance!! Since when did you switch to the other side of the equation?! You're subtracting your only chance, you're You're wasting everything I've done for you!
Revelations in Fall#258.dst: 君の任務は潜入で、レジスタンスに加算されることではない！！いつ方程式の反対側に移項した？！唯一の機会を引き算している、君は― 私が君にしてきた全てを無駄にしている！
Revelations in Fall#258.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#259.src: So after everything She did to me, you expected me to just go along with it?! To accept the scraps I was left with, to forgive and forget?!
Revelations in Fall#259.dst: 女王が私にしたことの後で、ただ従うと思っていたの？！残りかすを受け入れて、水に流せと？！
Revelations in Fall#259.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#260.src: Maybe you were the fool all along, Zhiraok, for believing it.
Revelations in Fall#260.dst: 最初から愚かだったのはあなたかもね、Zhiraok。それを信じたのだから。
Revelations in Fall#260.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#262.src: ...so it was all imaginary? Nothing real? I cared about you, as a friend. A confidant. Did you? Or...was I just a convenient tool for you?
Revelations in Fall#262.dst: …では全部虚数だったと？何ひとつ実在しないと？私は友として君を大切に思っていた。腹心として。君は？それとも… 私は都合のいい道具か？
Revelations in Fall#262.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#264.src: Does it...matter. ...ha. Does it matter!! Do you know how much weight you carried in my day to day operations? I wonder how much I carried in yours!!
Revelations in Fall#264.dst: 重要か…だと。…はっ。重要か、だと！！日々の業務で君がどれだけ重みを占めていたか分かるか？私は君の中でどれほどだったのだろうな！！
Revelations in Fall#264.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#265.src: It doesn't make me happy to do this. Your resistance is under arrest for the crime of conspiracy against the crown and your cursed, slated for execution.
Revelations in Fall#265.dst: こんなことをしても嬉しくはない。君のレジスタンスは王家への陰謀の罪で逮捕、そして君の呪われし者は処刑予定だ。
Revelations in Fall#265.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#266.src: I can still pull some strings, Syndra. Round this all out. I might be able to keep you as part of the remainder if you turn yourself in. We can still
Revelations in Fall#266.dst: まだ手は回せる、Syndra。全部丸めてやる。自首すれば、君を余りとして残せるかもしれない。我々はまだ
Revelations in Fall#266.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#267.src: We won't give in without a fight!
Revelations in Fall#267.dst: 戦わずに屈したりしない！
Revelations in Fall#267.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#268.src: ...why...do I even bother. A cursed compared to me...absolute trash. Let's get this over with.
Revelations in Fall#268.dst: …なぜ… 私はこうも構うのか。呪われし者など私と比べれば… ゴミ同然。さっさと片付けよう。
Revelations in Fall#268.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#269.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で君主 Zhiraok を倒す。

Revelations in Fall#270.dst: 終わった… 終わったわ。
Revelations in Fall#270.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#271.src: S- Syndra, are- are y- you
Revelations in Fall#271.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#277.src: Let's move. Everyone, remember the meeting point, just
Revelations in Fall#277.dst: 行くわよ。みんな、合流地点を忘れないで、ただ
Revelations in Fall#277.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#278.src: Are we really glossing over you killing a Sovereign????
Revelations in Fall#278.dst: 君主を殺したこと、本当にスルーするの？？？？
Revelations in Fall#278.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#279.src: Yes, Rex, because he won't stay down for long- that's why we need to move, now!
Revelations in Fall#279.dst: ええ、Rex、彼はすぐ起き上がるから― だから今すぐ動かないといけないの！
Revelations in Fall#279.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#280.src: Split up, stay safe, don't get caught. We meet in three days now, GO!
Revelations in Fall#280.dst: 散って、無事でいて、捕まらないで。三日後に合流よ、行って！
Revelations in Fall#280.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#281.src: Sovereign Zhiraok, sir! You have a visitor here!
Revelations in Fall#281.dst: 君主 Zhiraok 閣下！お客様です！
Revelations in Fall#281.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#282.src: Send them in, and if you could process these files, please-and-thank-you? I need the inquisitor to weigh in on the problem.
Revelations in Fall#282.dst: 通してくれ。それとこの書類を処理してもらえるかな、よろしく頼む。この件は異端審問官の意見が要る。
Revelations in Fall#282.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#283.src: I have a finite value of time for this, so let's keep this short
Revelations in Fall#283.dst: これに割ける時間は有限だ、手短に頼む
Revelations in Fall#283.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#285.src: Hello, Sovereign. Sorry to interrupt you during your working hours once again.
Revelations in Fall#285.dst: こんにちは、君主。また勤務中にお邪魔してごめんなさい。
Revelations in Fall#285.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#286.src: I'll add it to the tally! Bringing the trouble straight to my office, too You've got me nervous with the number of times it's happened recently.
Revelations in Fall#286.dst: 集計に加えておこう！しかも厄介事を執務室に直接持ち込むとは― 最近の回数の多さに緊張してきたよ。
Revelations in Fall#286.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#287.src: Let's cut to the chase, then. Tell me what your angle Ugh. What your request is.
Revelations in Fall#287.dst: では本題に入ろう。君の狙いを― はあ。君の要望を言ってくれ。
Revelations in Fall#287.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#288.src: Don't hold it in, you'll get an ulcer. I'll make this quick I need passage to the Roughworks. For myself and five others.
Revelations in Fall#288.dst: 我慢しないで、胃潰瘍になるわよ。手短に― Roughworks への通行許可が要るの。私と、他に五人分。
Revelations in Fall#288.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#289.src: ...you're really asking me to square the circle here. Why do you need to do this, go there? And so suddenly? Why?
Revelations in Fall#289.dst: …円を正方形にしろと言っているようなものだぞ。なぜそんなことを、あそこへ？しかも急に？なぜだ？
Revelations in Fall#289.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#290.src: I... I need to find her. I don't know how much more time I'll have to try.
Revelations in Fall#290.dst: 私… 彼女を見つけないと。あとどれだけ試す時間があるか分からない。
Revelations in Fall#290.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#291.src: I know, I know!! Quit being obtuse, you know the consequences if you break the mandate, for both of us!!
Revelations in Fall#291.dst: 分かっている、分かっている！！鈍いふりはやめろ、命令に背けばどうなるか分かっているだろう、二人ともだ！！
Revelations in Fall#291.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#293.src: ...Is that all I get? What about the other five?
Revelations in Fall#293.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#295.src: Of course. You and your strays. Why can't you just... There has to be another solution, if we If you I
Revelations in Fall#295.dst: 当然だな。君と迷い子たち。なぜ君はただ… 別の解があるはずだ、もし我々が― もし君が― 私が
Revelations in Fall#295.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#297.src: ...why do I even bother. Fine. You want it so badly, fine!! You know what this will take. Just... Remember. Remember what I've done for you.
Revelations in Fall#297.dst: …なぜ私はこうも構うのか。いいだろう。そこまで望むなら、いいだろう！！何が必要か分かっているな。ただ… 覚えておけ。私が君に何をしてやったか。
Revelations in Fall#297.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#298.src: Thank you, Zhiraok. I won't let your kindness go to waste.
Revelations in Fall#298.dst: ありがとう、Zhiraok。あなたの厚意は無駄にしないわ。
Revelations in Fall#298.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#299.src: Sovereign Zhiraok! Inquisitor Renn has some concerns
Revelations in Fall#299.dst: 君主 Zhiraok 閣下！異端審問官 Renn が懸念を
Revelations in Fall#299.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#300.src: Xao, I need you to clear my schedule. There's a higher priority now, he can wait.
Revelations in Fall#300.dst: Xao、予定を空けてくれ。今はもっと優先すべきことがある、彼は待たせればいい。
Revelations in Fall#300.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#301.src: Oh! Um, of course! If you insist, sir!! Inquisitor Renn won't be happy, but your orders are top
Revelations in Fall#301.dst: あっ！は、はい、もちろんです！閣下がそうおっしゃるなら！！Renn 殿はご不満でしょうが、閣下のご命令が最優
Revelations in Fall#301.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#302.src: No, you're right, I'm being irrational. You're always right. Clear everything but that, it's fine. I'll get back to it later. Unexpected variables, extenuating circumstances...
Revelations in Fall#302.dst: いや、君の言う通りだ、私は非合理的だった。君はいつも正しい。それ以外は全部空けてくれ、それでいい。後で戻る。予期せぬ変数、酌量すべき事情…
Revelations in Fall#302.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#303.src: Sov ...Zhi-Zhi? Is everything okay? You...you look rattled, was it something she said? Should I have not brought her
Revelations in Fall#303.dst: 閣… …Zhi-Zhi？大丈夫ですか？動揺して見えます、彼女に何か言われましたか？お通しすべきでは
Revelations in Fall#303.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#304.src: You didn't do anything wrong. She gave me a prime opportunity anyway. A warning before throwing my sequence out of line.
Revelations in Fall#304.dst: 君は何も悪くない。むしろ彼女は絶好の機会をくれた。私の数列を乱す前に警告をな。
Revelations in Fall#304.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#305.src: Xao, I trust you. I need to leave Auburn in your care for a bit while I solve this. Please. Can you handle that?
Revelations in Fall#305.dst: Xao、君を信頼している。この件を解くまで、しばらく Auburn を任せたい。頼む。できるか？
Revelations in Fall#305.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#306.src: ...oh my, I... It's an honor! I won't let you down, sir!! I'll keep things ship-shape! But, why do you need me for this?
Revelations in Fall#306.dst: …まあ、私… 光栄です！ご期待に背きません、閣下！！万事きっちり整えておきます！でも、なぜ私に？
Revelations in Fall#306.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#307.src: ...I need to converge at the Roughworks, handle her work for a while. That, and the next Crown Festival is soon. I feel like...it'd be a disservice to miss it.
Revelations in Fall#307.dst: …Roughworks に収束しなければならない。しばらく彼女の仕事を肩代わりする。それに次の王冠祭も近い。見逃すのは… 職務怠慢な気がしてね。
Revelations in Fall#307.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#000~1.src: They had the potential to be dangerous. Sometimes, they were. But more often than not, they were heroes. They used their power to protect people in need.
Revelations in Fall#000~1.dst: 彼らは危険になり得た。時には実際そうだった。だが多くの場合、彼らは英雄だった。困っている人々を守るために力を使ったのだ。

Revelations in Fall#006~1.src: Additionally, our risks of operation grow by the day. I do not regret taking in {u} as a member, but it's no secret that we risk more scrutiny by having them here.
Revelations in Fall#006~1.dst: それに、私たちの活動の危険は日に日に増している。{u} を仲間にしたことは後悔していないけど、ここにいることで目をつけられやすいのは明らかよ。
Revelations in Fall#006~1.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#034~1.src: Ah, no matter! Come now, other children... and {u}, of course! Let us all take some time to say our goodbyes. We don't know when we'll be back, after all!
Revelations in Fall#034~1.dst: ああ、構いません！さあ、他の子たちも…もちろん {u} も！皆で別れの挨拶をしましょう。いつ戻れるかわかりませんからね！
Revelations in Fall#034~1.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#128~1.src: I'm just... scared. I'm scared that- that if I try to use it, then, I'll, h-hurt someone...
Revelations in Fall#128~1.dst: 私…怖いの。もし、もし使ったら、誰かを、き、傷つけそうで…
Revelations in Fall#128~1.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#135~1.src: What if... something happened to them- to you - and, and, and- and I wasn't, there? I'd... I'd never f-forgive myself!
Revelations in Fall#135~1.dst: もしみんなに- あなたに- 何かあって、それで、それで- 私がそこにいなかったら？絶対に、じ、自分を許せない！
Revelations in Fall#135~1.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#258~1.src: Isn't it obvious, Sovereign? I want Her Majesty dethroned. I want her empire to crumble.
Revelations in Fall#258~1.dst: 明らかでしょう、君主？女王陛下を退位させたいの。彼女の帝国を崩壊させたい。
Revelations in Fall#258~1.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#289~1.src: Don't hold it in, you'll get an ulcer. I'll make this quick- I need passage to the Roughworks. For myself and five others.
Revelations in Fall#289~1.dst: 我慢しないで、胃に穴が開くわよ。手短に言う- Roughworks への通行許可が必要なの。私と、あと五人分。
Revelations in Fall#289~1.speaker: Syndra
